hypothesis: A minimum supplemental brake of 0.04 just above target+0.5 can repeatedly overcorrect small speed errors in visible compound avoidance. Tapering only this supplemental onset may preserve speed without changing steering, target or the base speed brake.
single_factor: For currently visible qualified adaptive compound hazards only, supplemental brake is multiplied by clip(excess/2,0,1), excess=speed-command_target-0.5; output stays at least base_brake. At excess>=2 all actions are control-exact.
eligibility: Obstacle-side latch nonzero, miss count zero, latched target30, current command strictly above30 and at most38, sweep in[6,12). Parent final steering veto must already have passed; strong steering resets command30.
static_acceptance: stateful differential and package tests pass
cell_status: Previously consumed or video-recovered diagnostic cells only; reuse is explicitly for paired regression diagnosis, never fresh confirmation or SOTA. No reserved confirmation/blind cell may be opened.
budget: One control and one candidate rollout per cell; no retuning or replacement candidate after results. Preserve all outcomes including errors.
execution_gate: Restore source-cited required docs and report.pdf; inspect relevant official sources; static tests pass; freeze source/model/protocol hashes before first reset; verify reserved partitions excluded.
decision: REJECT on any operational failure, finish loss, collision/damage increase, off-track regression, or reduced progress on paired DNF. Retain as diagnostic candidate only if no regressions and summed time of paired completed cells strictly decreases. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE and keep current route. Never PROMOTE from these reused cells.
